items.paraphrase: Walking distance from a room in an apartment/hotel type use to a direct stair; 50 m when main structure is fire-resistant/quasi-fire-resistant/noncombustible, else 30 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Same limit for general rooms such as offices: 50 m with fire-rated or noncombustible structure, 40 m otherwise; plus 10 m with quasi-noncombustible finishes (Art. 120 para 2).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.clause: Art. 19 para 3 table, row 3 (under Act Art. 28)
items.paraphrase: Effective daylight opening area must be at least one seventh of the floor area of dwelling living rooms; it is effective area, not nominal glazing.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Corridors on the accessible route need a clear width of at least 120 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Doors on the accessible route need a clear opening of at least 80 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.clause: Design standard (guidance, not Order text): wheelchair toilet cubicle inscribed circle at least 150 cm diameter; revised to 180 cm for large public buildings of 2000 m2 and above
items.paraphrase: The ministry design standard uses a 150 cm inscribed circle for wheelchair turning, raised to 180 cm for toilets in buildings over 2000 m2 serving the public.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: mlit.go.jp/common/001391184.pdf; 150 cm is the baseline turning circle in the ministry design standard; 180 cm applies to large public toilets after the 2021 revision; not binding law text

items.paraphrase: Ramp gradient on the accessible route may not exceed 1:12 (1:8 where the rise is 16 cm or less).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Fire-rated buildings over 1500 m2 must be divided by one-hour rated construction into compartments of at most 1500 m2.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.clause: Art. 112 para 1 (half-area counting for automatic sprinkler zones)
items.paraphrase: Floor area covered by automatic sprinklers counts at half, so a fully sprinklered floor allows about double the compartment size.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text); 3000 is derived by the half-count rule.

items.paraphrase: For stairs serving upper floors with over 200 m2 of habitable rooms (typical shared apartment stairs): riser at most 20 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text); row 4 (smaller floors) allows 22 cm.

items.paraphrase: Same row: tread at least 24 cm (21 cm in row 4).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Same row: stair and landing width at least 120 cm (75 cm in row 4).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Stairs inside a dwelling (not shared apartment stairs) may have risers up to 23 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Stairs inside a dwelling may have treads as small as 15 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Dwelling stairs fall in the general row: width at least 75 cm.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms need a ceiling height of at least 2.1 m (average where the ceiling varies).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.paraphrase: The same 2.1 m applies to any habitable room including offices; occupational health rules may demand more.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.clause: Art. 85 table, row 1, column for floor design
items.paraphrase: Floor slab design load for dwelling rooms is 1800 N/m2 (1300 for frames, 600 for seismic).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)

items.clause: Art. 85 table, row 2, column for floor design
items.paraphrase: Floor slab design load for offices is 2900 N/m2 (1800 for frames, 800 for seismic).
items.note: read 2026-11-14 via e-Gov law data API (consolidated text)
